verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own non-interactive API surface: an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow (machine-to-machine auth) with retrieval and batch-update endpoints, async job polling and webhooks, so headless scripted automation of its expense data is possible. There is no CLI, CI integration or headless-run guidance, and the MCP server authenticates through an interactive Navan login (SSO or username/password), so it is not built for unattended pipelines. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, non-interactive auth for the MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
